connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package cachetank-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the jacobsilver7-art account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
